name: 3d-fabric-marketplace
description: Marketplace for the 3d-fabric plugin: the whole 3D toolchain, from a printable part through SolidCraft to a print-checked mesh, and from a Blender scene to a rendered, validated animation.

plugins.name: 3d-fabric
plugins.description: The complete 3D toolchain in one plugin: printable CAD by natural language through the local SolidCraft CLI (build, edit, measure, preview, inspect, repair), plus thirty Blender skills for organic modelling, materials, lighting, cameras, rendering and animation. The Blender half is the MIT-licensed cc-blender-skill suite by RobLe3 (github.com/RobLe3/cc-blender-skill), bundled verbatim.
